lines: // Red: hunt nearest blue in vision — but a full red rests, and blues sheltered
// under a tree canopy cannot be contacted (a refuge that lets rare blues recover).
-      if (b.energy < 78) for (const bl of S.blues) { if (bl.energy <= 0) continue; const d = Math.hypot(bl.x - b.x, bl.y - b.y); if (d < vision && d < pd) { pd = d; prey = bl; } }
+      if (b.energy < 68) for (const bl of S.blues) { if (bl.energy <= 14) continue; const d = Math.hypot(bl.x - b.x, bl.y - b.y); if (d < vision && d < pd) { pd = d; prey = bl; } }
steer(b, prey.x + prey.vx * 0.18, prey.y + prey.vy * 0.18, baseSpeed, dt);
